definitions.explanation: A house or dwelling that is available for rent. Distinguished from apartments or single rooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貸家|かしや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are there any houses for rent around here?

examples.japanese: {貸家|かしや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧10⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The rent for the rental house is 100,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{貸家|かしや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for an old house for rent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{貸家|かしや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The landlord is managing this rental house.

examples.japanese: {貸家|かしや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I decided to rent out my house.

notes:
ALTERNATIVE READING: Also read as かしいえ, but かしや is more common.

SIGNS:
・「{貸家|かしや}」 (House for Rent)
・「{貸家|かしや}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧」 (Rental house available)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{貸間|かしま}→貸間：00193_kashima⟧ (room for rent)
・⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (rental housing - formal)
・⟦{借家|しゃくや}→借家：19997_shakka⟧ (rented house - from tenant's perspective)
・⟦{持|も}ち{家|いえ}→持ち家：27371_mochiie⟧ (owned home - opposite)

CONTRAST:
・{貸家|かしや} (renting out - owner's perspective)
・⟦{借家|しゃくや}→借家：19997_shakka⟧ (renting - tenant's perspective)

NOTE: In real estate contexts, ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦{一戸建|いっこだ}て→一戸建て：19687_ikkodate⟧ (rental single-family house) is often used in modern listings.
